title: 機密運算與可信執行環境
titleEn: Confidential computing and trusted execution environments
summary: 以記憶體保護、遠端證明與秘密釋放串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect memory protection, remote attestation and secret release through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 威胁模型：架構與原理
steps.objective: 針對「威胁模型」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For threat models, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「威胁模型」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「保護邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around threat models, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat protection boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「威胁模型」與「保護邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for threat models and protection boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「威胁模型」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for threat models. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。
knowledge.textEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「保護邊界」：保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「威胁模型」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring protection boundaries: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove threat models passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想證明 15 ms、驗證 5 ms、秘密傳送 10 ms，串行初始化合 30 ms；若每秒 100 次初始作業且不可並行，每秒需 3 s 處理，單通道不足。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed attestation=15 ms, verification=5 ms and secret transfer=10 ms give 30 ms serial initialization; 100 starts/s require 3 processing-seconds/s, exceeding one serial channel.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「機密運算與可信執行環境」的「威胁模型：架構與原理」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Threat models: architecture and principle” in “Confidential computing and trusted execution environments”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 針對「威胁模型」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of threat models?
options: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。
機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。
只檢查「保護邊界」，便可取代「威胁模型」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first.
Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug.
Checking protection boundaries alone replaces verification specific to threat models.
quiz.explanation: 先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。 相鄰的「保護邊界」有不同責任：保護來宾記憶體不等於保護所有外部 I/O。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Neighboring protection boundaries has a different role: Protecting guest memory does not protect every external I/O path. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 威胁模型：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Threat models: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「威胁模型」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For threat models, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「先定義不信任 host 的哪些能力與保護目標。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「保護邊界」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Define distrusted-host capabilities and protection goals first. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from protection boundaries to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「威胁模型」與「保護邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for threat models and protection boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「威胁模型」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for threat models. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「記憶體加密」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：加密與完整性保護是不同性質。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「受測工作負載」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around memory encryption, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Encryption and integrity protection are distinct properties. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat measured workloads as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 比較「記憶體加密」與「受測工作負載」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Compare whether evidence for memory encryption and measured workloads supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「記憶體加密」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for memory encryption. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.text: 加密與完整性保護是不同性質。
knowledge.textEn: Encryption and integrity protection are distinct properties.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「受測工作負載」：測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「記憶體加密」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring measured workloads: Measurements represent reviewable versions/configurations. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove memory encryption passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定工作負載，只改預期測量值。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix workloads and vary expected measurements. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「記憶體加密」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of memory encryption?
options: 機密運算使應用自身所有錯誤自動消失。
只檢查「受測工作負載」，便可取代「記憶體加密」的專屬驗證。
加密與完整性保護是不同性質。
optionsEn: Confidential computing automatically removes every application bug.
Checking measured workloads alone replaces verification specific to memory encryption.
Encryption and integrity protection are distinct properties.
quiz.explanation: 加密與完整性保護是不同性質。 相鄰的「受測工作負載」有不同責任：測量值須代表可審查版本及配置。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
